mockExams.title: GCE A Level mock — Chemistry (paper 1)
mockExams.instructions: Answer all questions. Section A has four short multiple-choice questions (2 marks each); Section B has three structured questions (4 marks each). The paper is marked out of 20. Data: F = 96 500 C mol⁻¹, K_w = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴, A_r: H 1, C 12, O 16. This is an original practice paper; its format is not that of the Cameroon GCE Board and should be checked against the official texts.
